newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - May 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - May 19.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on May 19. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

The eighth round of campaigning for the ruling Golkar party in the capital Jakarta was marred by widespread clashes between its supporters and backers of the Moslem-based United Development Party (PPP).
In the central Java city of Yogyakarta further election violence between Golkar and PPP supporters have moved in the direction of religious, racial and tribal clashes.
Representatives of the three political parties have issued a statement pledging not to hold large rallies or parades in the capital during the last week of campaigning.
Police suspect that witchdoctor who has admitted to killing 42 women in North Sumatra may have murdered even more victims.
The general chairman of the ruling Golkar party Harmoko is confident its target of 70.02 percent of the vote in the May 29 poll can be exceeded.
